V1 admits no callable types: GNT-3-T-GENERIC-CALL states that closure types remain unadmitted, so no v1 profile computes a callable row. The row contract binds the admission owned by GNT-GP-CLOSURE-001.
Callable-typed parameters and captures do not exist in v1; the composition rule binds GNT-GP-CLOSURE-001, and the existing closed call-graph fixed point remains covered by GNT-3-T-EFFECTS.
The no-erasure and determinism rules have callable types as their subject; the purity and fixed-point rules they preserve are covered by GNT-3-T-EFFECTS.

Closures, resource operations, agent handlers, and imported tools are not admitted in v1; their row obligations are owned by GNT-GP-CLOSURE-001, GNT-GP-OP-001, GNT-GP-HANDLER-001, and GNT-GP-TOOL-001.

V1 selects no target, feature, or dependency solution and retains the complete analyzed package, so the closure reduces to the action signatures Section 7 item 2 already resolves; the general computation binds GNT-GP-TARGET-001 and GNT-GP-LINK-001.

The v1 integration preflight resolves the action signatures of the analyzed package under Section 7 item 2; closure consumption and target selection are owned by GNT-GP-LINK-001 and GNT-GP-TARGET-001.

V1 retains the executable package reachable from its entry point and public interface, so an unreachable declaration is not a retained root and contributes no authority; the least-authority rule for partial solutions binds GNT-GP-LINK-001 and GNT-GP-TARGET-001.
The embedding surface has no dependency or feature selection in v1; the least-authority preflight rule binds GNT-GP-LINK-001 and GNT-GP-TARGET-001.
No v1 artifact publishes an authority closure, so the fail-closed publication rule has no v1 surface; it binds the linker and target selection owned by GNT-GP-LINK-001 and GNT-GP-TARGET-001.
V1 exposes no authority-closure state through the embedding boundary, so no publication rule applies to this profile yet; it binds GNT-GP-LINK-001.

V1 mapping revisions may change on resume under Section 7 item 2, but the closure is stated over canonical signatures and requirement slots, so a revision change is not a closure mutation; the immutability rule for discovered inventories binds GNT-GP-TOOL-001 and GNT-GP-AGENT-SPEC-001.
The embedding boundary exposes no mutable tool-set; a Section 7 item 2 mapping-revision change is not a closure mutation, and the immutability rule binds GNT-GP-TOOL-001 and GNT-GP-AGENT-SPEC-001.

The exclusions name contracts the other items of this section own: argument loans, task or channel transfer, resources, and the unwind, cancellation, and suspension duties. This increment claims no analyzer evidence for them.

The clauses of GNT-16 govern an edition or profile that resolves more than one package in one execution. The analyzer profile is the v1 single-package profile (GNT-4.6 excludes package resolution, GNT-4.9 excludes visibility constraints, and GNT-13.3 admits no import alias and no visibility modifier), so the Applicability paragraph of Section 16 requires this clause to be recorded not-applicable rather than satisfied.
